description.value: 1181 Lounge is an LGBTQ-primary bar on Vancouver's Davie Street, known for craft cocktails, resident DJs, and a casual modern atmosphere. It is a well-established fixture of the city's gay village, drawing a lively crowd for music and nightlife. Touring cyclists visiting Vancouver's West End will find it near the Seawall and Davie Village.
